snippet.title: KEPLERIANS CHALLENGE | ESCAPE THE NUN V1.0 | WITH THE LIGHTS OFF
snippet.description:
Keplerian developers have set themselves a challenge in The Nun V1.0. 

Will they be able to play this game with the lights off? Remember that this old version of The Nun was the first horror game we did. It isn't currently to download in Google play or App Store. Did you like the game? It was terrifying, wasn't it?

If you want more videos like this, write us in the comments. You can propose more challenges too. Greetings to all!
